company.name: EyeGo
company.shortDescription: EyeGo is an AI-powered hospitality intelligence platform that uses computer vision and IoT technologies to improve operational efficiency.
company.description: EyeGo develops advanced AIoT solutions for the hospitality sector, enabling businesses to transform video feeds and operational data into actionable insights. The platform integrates AI-powered cameras, edge computing, cloud analytics, and IoT infrastructure to deliver real-time monitoring, QA inspections, crowd management, people counting, hygiene compliance, and workflow optimization. EyeGo’s solutions are designed for restaurants, hotels, malls, cafés, and other hospitality environments where operational visibility and customer experience are critical. Its technology supports features such as HACCP food safety compliance monitoring, PPE detection, spill detection, occupancy analytics, and live dashboards that work with existing camera systems. The company operates from Saudi Arabia and the UAE and positions itself as a smart hospitality intelligence platform focused on sustainability, automation, and operational excellence.
